description:
A command line interface for the Nitrokey FIDO2, Nitrokey Start, Nitrokey 3 and NetHSM.


## What's Changed
• trussed：Add model and revision to status output by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/795
• Allow cryptography <53 by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/798
• Use secrets rather than random to generate secrets by @dirkmueller in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/800
• nk3：secret: Make get-password pipe compatible by @symptog in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/801
• Fix typo in NetHSM error message by @mmerklinger in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/802

## New Contributors
• @dirkmueller made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/800
• @symptog made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/801

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/compare/v0.13.0...v0.14.0
